correctness.rationale: The geometric basis contains exactly E_i, L_ij, Q with explicit intersection pairings; negative definite supports equal disjoint curve sets because intersecting pairs have semidefinite 2x2 submatrix. A Galois-invariant support B is realized by D=-K+2B=P+N with P=-K+B nef and big, P.E=0 exactly on B. The even-weight bit model is justified by the intersection matrix; the signed W(D5) action is the full faithful group. Two separate exact integer enumerators, one Hamming/affine and one Picard-lattice/reflection, generated all 1920 elements and 18 signed types; the 393 chamber masks, 18 independent profiles and all 18 fixed-support distributions agree. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for the finite Weyl group, not a field-size experiment.

value.rationale: This is a complete arithmetic refinement of a canonical 393-chamber stable-base-locus decomposition on degree-four del Pezzo surfaces. The eighteen signed Frobenius types classify which negative-support configurations descend and the entire extension-field chamber zeta spectrum. It detects genuine arithmetic phenomena invisible to rational exceptional-curve counts, e.g. two non-nef stable-base-locus chambers despite zero rational negative curves, and compares different splitting types. The invariant is motivated by Zariski decomposition and stable base loci rather than an arbitrarily chosen graph statistic; the result neither repeats BFN unrefined counts nor demands a downstream theorem to be meaningful.
